about: Gold set B2's sample (#695, #699): ids only, never text. scripts/gold-b2/sample.ts draws it from Europe PMC: every open-access paper the live search (searchQuery() in src/europepmc/client.ts) found, published up to the day it ran, less gold set B's papers (evals/gold-b.json), shuffled with the seed, and the first `size` of them. No check on a paper's text decides whether it joins. population counts the papers the search found, gold set B's among them. Run the script without --write to draw again and compare. The sheet lists the same papers in the same order.
query: ((ACK_FUND:"Cancer Research UK" OR ACK_FUND:"Cancer Research U.K." OR ACK_FUND:"CRUK" OR ACK_FUND:"CR-UK" OR ACK_FUND:"Cancer Research United Kingdom" OR ACK_FUND:"Cancer Research U.K") AND NOT GRANT_AGENCY:"Cancer Research UK" AND NOT PUB_TYPE:"retracted publication" AND NOT PUB_TYPE:"published erratum" AND NOT (PUB_TYPE:"correction" AND NOT PUB_TYPE:"corrected and republished article") AND FIRST_PDATE:[2020-01-01 TO 3000-12-31]) AND FIRST_PDATE:[1900-01-01 TO 2026-11-11]
